dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Phew, we're almost there. Once this is over, I'll be able to return to the ship!

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: Quite alright, quite alright. I've remained onshore enough, and I've made great progress in my research. Our sampling order is just about complete!

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: Hahah! To think that we were able to get this done without the Captain's help... I can't wait to see how shocked she'll be at our progress!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your progress in making me do your job for you, you mean?

response.speaker: Muzhen
response.text: Oh, and, ah... your progress, of course! It's been quite splendid, it has!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Guess Captain Beidou's got some unreliable subordinates too, huh...
